# OBJECT_STORE

An S3-compatible endpoint and the credentials, if any, needed to reach it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `objectStore`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.objectStore`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| credentials | null or record { accessKeyKey, name, namespace, secretKeyKey } |
| namespace | kubernetes name (DNS-1123 label) |
| s3Endpoint | string |
